name: China
status: Illustrative draft: author's judgement from general public knowledge; not yet evidence-reviewed
summary: Strongest on compute, models and state-led data institutions; weakest on consent and open, permissionless rails.
method: Scored against the same anchors and scoring rules as the India baseline. Items reflect the national picture. Review against current sources before use.

P1.evidence: Universal resident ID with national online identity authentication; near-ubiquitous mobile payments run by private platforms, with clearing via NetsUnion; e-CNY piloted; super-apps already deliver AI services
P1.assumption: Rails are at scale but largely platform-proprietary

P2.evidence: National Data Administration (2023); data exchanges in Shanghai and Shenzhen; public-data authorisation programmes; privacy-computing pilots; no consent-based sharing layer like DEPA
P2.assumption: Data flows are state-organised rather than user-consented

P3.evidence: Strong real-name authentication; PIPL (2021) requires consent but has no consent-manager role; generative-AI rules address training-data consent

P4.evidence: "East Data, West Computing" national compute network; state and local compute vouchers; export controls limit advanced GPUs; domestic accelerators scaling; leading open-weight models widely used
P4.assumption: Capacity is large, but advanced-chip supply is the constraint

P5.evidence: AI education introduced across schools; very large STEM and AI-researcher pool; top-ranked publication output; growing public-sector capacity
P5.assumption: Talent depth and breadth are both strong

P6.evidence: CAC-led rules: algorithm filing, deep-synthesis rules (2023), generative-AI interim measures (2023), AI-content labelling measures (2025); national AI standards work
P6.assumption: Rules are detailed and fast, with state control as the priority

P7.evidence: State-guided platforms and clearing houses; open-weight model releases; state guidance funds; building on rails needs platform or state approval

P8.evidence: AI services mainly in Mandarin with limited minority-language coverage; algorithm-filing oversight; little independent trust measurement; Digital Silk Road exports technology
P8.assumption: Reach is high; independent measures of trust are limited
